checks.semantic_requirement: Load an explicit, confined offline terminal bundle.
checks.actual_schema: No terminal bundle exporter is present in runtime commit b4d4823.
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE when manifest or referenced evidence is absent/invalid.

checks.semantic_requirement: Bind this run to exact sealed identity, runtime commit/tree, epoch and run ID.
checks.expected_schema: flat commit/tree names and auditor constants
checks.actual_runtime_field: identity.software_commit_sha, software_tree_sha; runtime.runtime_software_commit; sealed-manifest.identity_sha256 and artifact_hashes
checks.actual_schema: identity schema v1; runtime schema v1; runtime has no software_tree_sha
checks.current_verdict_behavior: Default constants pin 22e06b9/a44c959, so exact b4d4823/5c96ed7 identity is FAIL; exact override can pass.

checks.semantic_requirement: Prove actual elapsed wall and monotonic duration meets sealed 108000-second duration.
checks.expected_schema: Separate actual-start file plus supervisor result
checks.actual_runtime_field: result.started_at, ended_at, elapsed_seconds, collection_duration_seconds, full_duration_satisfied; runtime.duration_seconds
checks.actual_schema: Supervisor result schema v2 and runtime schema v1
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE if exporter does not map result.started_at to expected actual-start input.

checks.semantic_requirement: Require collector/scheduler success and permit only the explicitly normal publisher SIGTERM after collection.
checks.actual_runtime_field: collector_exit_code, archive_scheduler_exit_code, publisher_exit_code, publisher_stopped_after_collector, received_signal
checks.actual_schema: Supervisor result schema v2; successful post-collection publisher exit may be -15
checks.current_verdict_behavior: Original auditor returns FAIL for publisher_exit_code=-15 even when publisher_stopped_after_collector is true and collection succeeded.

checks.semantic_requirement: Verify terminal service result, main exit code, process identity/times, watchdog and signal from the exact invocation.
checks.actual_runtime_field: InvocationID in observer systemctl snapshot; journal records scoped by InvocationID
checks.actual_schema: Transient systemd unit can disappear; journal is durable, observer snapshot is partial
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE when systemd.json is missing; querying a removed transient unit is not authoritative.

checks.semantic_requirement: Treat an upload assertion as valid only after exact S3 GET/readback, byte/hash equality and captured VersionId.
checks.actual_runtime_field: terminal/terminal-receipt.json; s3_uploaded is serialized true before stable put_object returns
checks.actual_schema: Local stable and timestamped receipts; S3 stable key and optional timestamped key
checks.current_verdict_behavior: Original auditor may PASS from s3_uploaded=true without proving the object exists; source can leave a false positive after interruption.

checks.semantic_requirement: Require terminal lifecycle completion and final manifest flush evidence.
checks.actual_runtime_field: result.final_manifest_flush_observed and collector lifecycle path passed to collector
checks.actual_schema: Supervisor result plus collector-lifecycle.json
checks.current_verdict_behavior: PASS only when lifecycle export contains the expected terminal fields; absent file is NOT_VERIFIABLE.

checks.semantic_requirement: Require empty queue/unpersisted state and zero writer/drop errors while preserving counts.
checks.actual_runtime_field: collector_metrics.queue_size, unpersisted_event_count, exchanges.bithumb/binance/upbit writer and queue counters
checks.actual_schema: Nested metrics schema emitted by collector
checks.current_verdict_behavior: PASS/FAIL from exported metrics; missing metrics are NOT_VERIFIABLE.

checks.semantic_requirement: Verify configured and observed Bithumb active-active mode, two sockets, duplicate count and zero conflicts.
checks.expected_schema: Flat legacy booleans/counts plus nested bithumb metrics
checks.actual_runtime_field: runtime.bithumb_redundancy.mode/physical_connections; metrics.exchanges.bithumb.deduplicated_frames/conflicting_duplicate_frames
checks.actual_schema: Nested sealed redundancy object and nested exchange metrics
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE because flat runtime enable/count fields are absent, even though nested mode/count are present.

checks.semantic_requirement: Derive the exact fully contained UTC-hour set and bind each to the sealed 76-feed universe.
checks.expected_schema: Explicit sealed cohort list and feed identity list
checks.actual_runtime_field: identity.feed_count=76; runtime.schedule target_full_hours, qualification_rule and required_qualifying_full_hours; exact interval in result; pinned SEALED_FEED_UNIVERSE source
checks.actual_schema: Duration-only IMMEDIATE schedule with no cohort list; feed universe is in pinned runtime code
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE because the auditor requires an explicit list that the run seal does not emit.

checks.semantic_requirement: Require exactly one valid local coverage receipt for every expected full-hour/feed pair.
checks.expected_field: local_receipts/*coverage*archive-receipt*.json keyed by sealed cohort and feed universe
checks.expected_schema: Explicit expected cohort and feed arrays
checks.actual_runtime_field: coverage/journals/journal_<cohort>.json; archive-receipts/coverage/<cohort>/<exchange>/<stream>/<market>.coverage.json.archive-receipt.json
checks.actual_schema: Frozen 76-feed journal plus per-feed ArchiveReceiptV3/coverage evidence
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE without bundle-exported receipts/expected cohort derivation; receipt gaps or mismatches are FAIL.

checks.semantic_requirement: Compare only receipt types whose architecture requires an S3 mirror; reject missing, corrupt or unexpected in-scope remote receipt objects.
checks.expected_field: all receipt files under local_receipts and s3_receipts must be identical sets and bytes
checks.actual_runtime_field: ArchiveReceiptV3.remote_key/remote_checksum/remote_version_id; qualifying cohort JSON is uploaded; skipped partial cohort report is local-only; timestamped terminal S3 mirror is optional
checks.actual_schema: Typed receipt scopes with distinct durability requirements
checks.current_verdict_behavior: The original whole-tree equality rule can reject intended local-only/optional receipts or require mirrors outside the qualifying contract.

checks.semantic_requirement: Show unchanged bytes across independent observations and compare them with captured remote version/hash where required.
checks.expected_field: receipt_observations.qualifying_receipts with t1/t2 SHA256 and current hash
checks.actual_runtime_field: ArchiveReceiptV3 source/compressed/remote checksums and remote_version_id; independent observer captures are external
checks.actual_schema: One mutable receipt JSON updated through pipeline stages plus immutable observations only if captured by auditor
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE until two independent observations exist; one snapshot does not prove immutability.

checks.semantic_requirement: Verify completeness and integrity against an externally anchored sealed root, not an index that can be regenerated with edited files.
checks.actual_runtime_field: sealed-manifest.identity_sha256, sealed-manifest.artifact_hashes, identity.sealed_artifact_hashes, captured S3 VersionIds, journal export hashes
checks.actual_schema: Prelaunch sealed root plus terminal evidence index; current auditor checks only listed file hashes
checks.current_verdict_behavior: A modified bundle file plus regenerated local index can pass; empty/absent index is NOT_VERIFIABLE.

checks.semantic_requirement: Prove whether archive scheduler retry attempts occurred.
checks.actual_runtime_field: Supervisor log and scheduler status files; no native structured retry event stream
checks.actual_schema: Text log plus periodic status snapshot
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE when finalization trace is absent; empty synthetic events are treated as no retries.

checks.semantic_requirement: Prove per-slot finalizer retry attempts and outcomes.
checks.actual_runtime_field: write-ahead FinalizationProgressStore entries and current coverage/archive receipts
checks.actual_schema: Crash-safe transaction state, not a complete retry event history
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE without complete trace; current state may not distinguish all historical retry paths.

checks.semantic_requirement: Prove whether a recovery path was invoked.
checks.actual_runtime_field: No dedicated recovery-invocation producer in bounded collector/archive launch path
checks.actual_schema: Not emitted as a native field
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE without trace.

checks.semantic_requirement: Prove each cohort/feed was finalized at most once.
checks.actual_runtime_field: Immutable cohort receipt plus per-slot coverage/ArchiveReceiptV3 and write-ahead progress state
checks.actual_schema: Terminal state and partial transaction state; not necessarily a complete history
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE without trace; identical final output alone cannot prove no duplicate finalization.

checks.semantic_requirement: Prove retries/re-finalizations preserved closed_at_utc.
checks.actual_runtime_field: coverage receipt closed_at_utc and versioned historical receipt bytes if available
checks.actual_schema: Current receipt plus optional remote object versions
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE without repeated finalization evidence; one final value does not establish stability.

checks.semantic_requirement: Prove repeated finalization preserved evidence hashes.
checks.actual_runtime_field: coverage.evidence_sha256 and ArchiveReceiptV3 source/manifest hashes; optional S3 versions
checks.actual_schema: Current evidence binding without complete attempt history
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE without retry/re-finalization history.

checks.semantic_requirement: Prove whether the run exercised any restart/retry-sensitive finalization path and preserve the known runtime defect boundary.
checks.expected_field: derived from complete retry/recovery/finalization event trace
checks.actual_runtime_field: systemd InvocationID journal, write-ahead progress states, supervisor/archive logs and receipts
checks.actual_schema: Multiple partial sources; no single complete native terminal trace
checks.current_verdict_behavior: NOT_VERIFIABLE without complete trace; empty synthetic trace yields PASS for unexercised path.
